# The status checks branch protection on main requires (strict, so a PR must
# also be up to date with main). One per line; # starts a comment.
#
# scripts/check-required-contexts.sh asserts, in CI, that every context here
# still matches a job in the PR-gating workflows and that those workflows run
# on a bare `pull_request:` — a renamed job or a branches: filter would
# otherwise leave every PR waiting forever on a check that never reports.
#
# Changing branch protection? Update this list in the same breath:
#   gh api repos/neb-abera/Facewoof/branches/main/protection \
#     --jq '.required_status_checks.contexts[]'
lint and format
production image
smoke test against postgres
lint (actionlint + shellcheck)
analyze (javascript-typescript)
analyze (actions)
container scan (trivy)
dependency review
